title: QuantiFarm generic parcel information
description: Generic information about the parcel in the QuantiFarm testcase (elements filled with a value depending on type of cultivation)

parcelDimension.description: The dimension or area of the parcel in hectares

startMonth.description: The month in the calendar year in which the cultivation started

endMonth.description: The month in the calendar year in which the cultivation ended

productType.description: The type of product that is cultivated during the year on the parcel

numberOfEmployees.description: The number of employees that worked on the parcel

numberOfFulltimeEmployees.description: The number of full-time employees that worked on the parcel

numberOfSeasonalEmployees.description: The number of seasonal employees that worked on the parcel

soilFractionSand.description: The percentage of sand in the soil of the parcel

soilFractionClay.description: The percentage of clay in the soil of the parcel

soilFractionSilt.description: The percentage of silt in the soil of the parcel

bulkDensity.description: The bulk density of the parcel in kg/dm3 or g/cm3

soilOrganicCarbon.description: The percentage of organic carbon in the soil of the parcel

numberOfAnimals.description: The number of animals on the parcel

numberOfPlants.description: The number of plants on the parcel

livestockUnits.description: The livestock units on the parcel per hectare

numberOfBeehives.description: The number of beehives on the parcel

aquacultureArea.description: The area on the parcel used for aquaculture in square meters
